text: 据深圳市房地产中介协会统计数据，2026年8月二手房共计录得5535套，环比下跌3.3%，同比上涨5.1%；二手住宅共计录得5108套，环比下跌2.3%，同比上涨7.6%。8月份录得量虽较7月份继续小幅回落，但同比涨幅较上月进一步扩大，说明近期热度虽有所降温，但整体录得量仍明显高于去年同期水平，市场面依然稳固。（证券时报）
text_en: According to statistics from the Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association, second-hand housing transactions in August 2026 totaled 5,535 units, down 3.3% month-on-month and up 5.1% year-on-year; second-hand residential transactions reached 5,108 units, down 2.3% month-on-month and up 7.6% year-on-year. Although August volumes continued to edge lower from July, the year-on-year growth rate expanded further from the previous month, indicating that while recent momentum has cooled somewhat, overall volumes remain clearly above year-ago levels and the market remains stable. (Securities Times)
